purpose: Define the first production-oriented vertical contract that must be demonstrably closed from provider evidence through canonical identity, chart projection and public discovery.

golden_flow.product_outcome: A real provider song can be ingested, normalized, governed into a canonical song, projected into chart/public/search surfaces, and later corrected without manual cross-system repair.

evidence: rationale/audit for human decision when required
aliases/provider identity do not create duplicate public entities

golden_cases.description: One artist, one song, one provider identity.
The same canonical song observed from at least two providers without duplicate canonical/public entities.
Ambiguous artist naming must not auto-merge without sufficient governed evidence.
A rerelease/remaster case must preserve relationship/provenance semantics without accidental duplicate collapse.
Conflicting provider metadata must preserve evidence and route unresolved identity through governed review.

invariants: No canonical entity without traceable origin.
No chart row without canonical identity.
No chart row accepted as golden evidence without reproducible input/calculation provenance.
No provider evidence may become canonical identity merely because it was fetched successfully.
No rejected or unresolved admission may leak into canonical public projection.
Repeating the same provider input must be idempotent at observation/canonical projection boundaries.
One semantic editorial correction must converge all dependent projections without direct manual database repair.
Public song, artist, chart, search and SEO surfaces must agree on canonical identity.

verification_surface.stage_22_1_rule: Stage 22.1 may define the command contract and bind existing verification owners; it must not add a parallel verification engine when existing test/impact/canonical lanes can own the checks.
verification_surface.machine_output: A future implementation should emit bounded JSON containing exact source identity, case results, failed edge ids and owning verification lanes.
